## IMPULSE 0.7.0

Gameplay expands beyond the original campaign with three new particle behaviors while preserving the one-tap core.

### Highlights

- Campaign expanded from 20 to 40 deterministic levels.
- New **Booster** particles emit a larger, faster reaction wave.
- New **Fuse** particles delay their wave briefly, changing chain timing without adding another input.
- New **Anchor** particles stay fixed and act as reliable relay points.
- Levels 21–35 introduce the mechanics progressively; levels 36–40 combine them.
- Special particles have distinct neon markers and wave colors that remain readable with reduced effects enabled.
- Contextual mechanic hints are available in English and Russian.
- Players who completed the previous 20-level campaign automatically continue from level 21 with existing progress preserved.
- Android version is now 0.7.0 with versionCode 9.

The game remains fully offline with no account, analytics, ads, backend, or INTERNET permission. Release artifacts are signed with the existing project release certificate and published with SHA-256 checksums and GitHub artifact attestations.
